title: C: BMI Calculator
description: Calculate BMI from weight (kg) and height (m) and classify it into categories.

steps.title: Calculate and Classify BMI
steps.description: Declare `double weight = 70.0, height = 1.75`. Compute BMI = weight / (height * height). Classify: <18.5 Underweight, 18.5-24.9 Normal, 25-29.9 Overweight, 30+ Obese. Print both BMI and category.
